svg.title: Climate Compass for Kathmandu Valley respiratory health
svg.desc: Air quality data sources flowing into predictive models, triggering alerts to health facilities and parents, with measurable respiratory outcomes for children

g.text: Predicts: Days 2-7 respiratory admissions in under-5s based on air quality + meteorology
Output: "High risk" / "Moderate" / "Low" for each health facility + district

g.style: fill: #FAEEDA; stroke: #854F0B; stroke-width: 0.5; stroke-opacity: 0.4;;fill:rgb(250, 238, 218);stroke:rgb(133, 79, 11);color:rgb(255, 255, 255);stroke-width:0.5px;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:"Anthropic Sans", -apple-system, "system-ui", "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start;dominant-baseline:auto
g.text: → Health facilities: SMS + Dashboard (action: pre-stock O₂, bronchodilators, staffing)
→ Parents/schools: SMS (action: reduce outdoor time, avoid strenuous activities)
↓ Under-5 respiratory ED visits on high air quality days (vs. historical)
↑ Facility oxygen availability during surge (stockout reduction from 35% → <5%)
